behavior: One oldest verified matching inventory entry per discard; recorded bought date before capture date; no last-edited ordering.
Same shared identity policy for Halo photo discards and QuickAck voice/app discard_item; zero-quantity removal uses the same path.
Current voice transcript must authorize removal. Model-selected IDs do not bypass semantic validation.
Uncertain identities, mixed product variants, model errors and no-match results do not authorize a fuzzy fallback.
Frozen photo-job plan and actor/request-scoped voice journal prevent retries selecting a second duplicate, including after household transfer.
Membership checks, full snapshot/revision checks and atomic archive/discard writes protect customer changes.

validation.test_db: Disposable MySQL 8.4 on loopback port 33387 for local tests; four isolated synthetic households for live serving-package and Lambda canaries. No customer records changed.

historical_originals.qualification: The raspberry recognition remained explicitly uncertain after package review. Canonical pipeline correctly saved no kitchen-removal authorization. Initial raw-name matcher replay omitted that flag; both results retained privately. No accuracy claim beyond these cases.

live_canaries.voice_input: Legacy and streaming JSON transcripts; asynchronous worker received synthetic 24 kHz spoken audio.
live_canaries.photo_input: Original historical broccoli JPEG uploaded through live durable presign route under isolated synthetic ownership.
live_canaries.verified: Exact original target, remaining duplicate, oil/chips/dressing or soup decoys, saved discard, SQL changes and app-serving API.

validation.retry_edge_case: Full streaming retry exposed optional model selection_hint drift. Fixed durable intent to ignore this unused hint, with first-release journal compatibility. Changed item/transcript and household transfer still fail closed.

live_retry_results.legacy: Original receipt returned; exact remaining inventory unchanged.
live_retry_results.stream: Same failed first-release operation replayed successfully after optional-hint fix; exact remaining inventory unchanged.
live_retry_results.async: Completed job replay was skipped; exact remaining inventory unchanged.
live_retry_results.photo: Packaged matcher preview, commit and repeated commit returned same target; live full photo handler and saved API results verified.

validation.post_deploy_logs_qualification: Finite verification window after each final deployment, not an ongoing monitoring guarantee.
validation.cleanup: Four synthetic profiles and derived SQL fixtures removed transactionally with private before/after receipts. Original media, job logs and validation evidence retained.

limits: Explicit bulk and partial-quantity requests are held for review rather than guessed. This change removes one inventory entry, not an inferred fraction of a multipack.
The separate private Thyme V2 tester uses its existing exact-row user approval and canonical revision-protected mutation route; not changed here.
Legacy WRITE_SHARED_ONLY=false removal is disabled rather than retaining unsafe fuzzy deletes.
Model tests are synthetic frozen inventories including the observed incident wording; they are not a claim of perfect accuracy.
No customer records were backfilled or restored. Historical media was read-only; original recognition pipeline is unchanged. Verification is API/database-based, not a visual phone inspection.

release.method: Build guarded overlays onto freshly downloaded serving ZIPs with scripts/discard-identity/build-overlay.py. Abort and rebase if touched source hashes drift.
preserve: All unrelated ZIP entries, including latest async job-id forwarding, consent adapters, date fixes and voice reliability changes.
Current environment; DISCARD_MATCH_MODEL defaults to gpt-6-astra. No schema migration.
preflight: Re-read current configurations/revisions and all touched serving sources.
Check voice session Dynamo table access supports the discard-actor partition and non-expiring retained request bodies.
Apply overlays with Lambda RevisionId safeguards, preserving independently changed files.
Run isolated canaries with synthetic inventory before any customer mutation; compare actual serving API results.
Keep previous ZIPs and revisions for rollback. Never deploy the full historical checkout.
release.consent_compatibility: Legacy synchronous package lacked the shared consent adapter. Bundled the exact current sibling adapter, bound model requests to the verified actor and added only dynamodb:GetItem on trepo-current-user-consents to its role. No environment or schema changes.
release.retry_patch: After the full release, overlay only kitchen-discard-plan.mjs on the three exact deployed voice ZIPs; verify every other byte and Lambda RevisionId before update.

provenance.shared_context: trepo-company recall returned no relevant discard policy page; no shared memory was written.
provenance.skill: gstack-land-and-deploy adapted to guarded Lambda overlays; telemetry and shared-memory writes disabled.
